audience: HOST ONLY; never supplied to native extraction stages
purpose: Check preservation, publication policy and query/render behavior of each fresh initial and final Workflow using existing tools. Python does not judge scientific correctness.
inputs_at_execution: Exact candidate artifact path and raw/canonical hashes from archived stage/run state
Frozen registered source packet and its raw/canonical hashes
For final publication: exact primary review, field review, source coverage, reader coverage and their sidecars/config/state pins
Frozen runtime implementation snapshots for reproduction; original source custody archive/manifest

exact_checks: Raw Workflow bytes match the archived artifact pin; canonical digest matches the stage/run binding.
Workflow method_id/title/scope/variant match the frozen packet; no rescoping or substitution of source version.
Workflow model validates typed IDs/I/O/Flows/acyclicity/module membership. validate_evidence checks every source_id/passage_id/quote against the packet.
Check original/rendition bytes through declared custody pins; preserve logical original paths in frozen artifacts.
checks.limits: CLI check replays registered original-file paths and therefore belongs where those originals exist. For a copied archive, use validated original-path/member mappings for byte custody plus the existing in-memory validators; do not rewrite historical paths or claim custody from quote matching alone.

exact_checks: Use the full execute() decision with source, reader and field gates fixed on, their exact sidecars and same-run revision lineage. A valid negative review is a completed scientific outcome, not a supported candidate.
Positive graph_candidate.json/protocol.txt/overview.json/overview.txt/overview.html may exist only for a final supported pipeline outcome with all configured gates satisfied.

Nonpositive primary review may have diagnostic exports. A source/reader/field veto over a positive primary review must have no positive export; current pipeline may withhold all production exports in that case.
Initial integrator artifacts have no inherited support verdict; any host preview must retain unreviewed status.
checks.limits: export_candidate() and review_outcome() alone check the primary review, not all pipeline gates. Do not use them as independent whole-pipeline admission. No atlas/canonical publication follows from a candidate export.

exact_checks: Report exact external-input, terminal-output and isolated State IDs, their attached Operations and conditions.
Compare any archived boundary_audit with recomputation from the same pinned Workflow.
Use diff_workflows(initial,final) to record exact boundary-inventory and stable-ID edits, without an arbitrary edit whitelist.
checks.limits: Producerless roots may be specimens, resources, designs or references; terminal States may be products, QC, reserves or discards. Topology neither supplies their fate nor establishes a source-backed boundary disposition.

exact_checks: For every Operation query, verify exact input/output State records, resource/Flow IDs, binding selection/conditions and Module membership agree with the Workflow.
Expand the existing lossless inspection view and require the same Workflow canonical hash.
Resolve every overview detail_pointer against the same original Workflow; reopen referenced evidence rather than treating display summaries as new source text.
checks.limits: Queries and lossless round trips establish identity/preservation only; they do not decide entailment or whether the chemical description is sufficient.

exact_checks: Choose pairs from the actual graph, including guarded Flow endpoints and input/output pairs around shared alternative Operations; no preselected biological record IDs or expected topology.
Any returned unconditional path contains only declared directed Flows with no condition and no optional/alternative selection.
Where only a guarded structural path exists, status is needs_route_selection, path_flow_ids is null, and the conditional candidate and blocked edge IDs/conditions remain explicit.
Disconnected directions report no_declared_path; unknown IDs raise rather than silently becoming empty nodes.
checks.limits: The algorithm never evaluates natural-language guards or correlates local alternative groups into a globally consistent route. A structural path, especially one starting downstream of a guard, is not a complete protocol: other required inputs may be absent. Do not claim biochemical compatibility or feasibility.

exact_checks: For an initial preview, use no review and retain unreviewed_projection.
For archived final exports, regenerate their content with the exact bound review and diagnostic status; compare exact overview JSON/text/HTML and protocol text without overwriting original exports.
CLI overview omits review context by design, so do not compare it against an archived reviewed overview as though they were identical calls.
Every overview State/Operation/Flow remains present with exact IDs, qualifications and detail pointers. HTML data-flow-id occurrences cover each declared Flow exactly once.
For a graph export, embedded Workflow/review/source_registry equal the bound inputs; original node/edge records and source refs retain the same IDs, quote locators, selection and conditions.
checks.limits: A deterministic render is not an LLM graph-to-protocol reconstruction, a visual-quality certificate, renewed review, completeness proof or executable schedule. Listed order is not execution order.

report_contract: Exact input paths, raw/canonical pins, frozen runtime identity and stage (initial/final).
Each check status and any mismatched record IDs/field pointers; missing artifacts are not successful checks.
Export grade and actual gate outcomes separate from source-backed host scientific judgments.
Boundary inventory and sampled/complete query denominators; no accuracy claim from counts.
Scientific limits and unresolved route assumptions retained in every user-facing view.
decision: Existing CLI and pure APIs are sufficient; no additional runner or duplicated validator is introduced.
